basic_info.description: Designer-Renovated 3BR/3BA Noe Condo with Panoramic Bay & Downtown Views. Flooded with natural light and showcasing breathtaking panoramic views of the Bay and Downtown, this fully redesigned 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom condo offers the ideal blend of modern luxury and open-concept living in a prime Noe Valley location. Tucked away in a quiet cul-de-sac, the home provides both privacy and convenience. A tree-lined staircase offers direct access to Noe Street, just moments from 24th Street's vibrant cafes, shops, and restaurants. The spacious living area is framed by floor-to-ceiling windows and a large sliding door that opens onto an expansive walkout deck with sweeping views perfect for entertaining. A quartz-wrapped fireplace anchors the space, flanked by custom-built shelving and a stylish bar. The chef's kitchen features quartz countertops with bar seating, a gas range, hood vent, stainless steel appliances, instant hot water, and soft-close cabinetry. The main level is complete with two skylights, a sunlit bedroom with city views, a beautifully remodeled bathroom, a large storage closet, and a brand-new stackable washer/dryer. Upstairs, two en-suite bedrooms offer privacy, each with remodeled bathrooms. The primary suite includes a private deck w/ stunning outlooks.
